claims.text: The hotel is in the heart of Muscat, steps from the Arabian Sea.

findings.quote: Our hotel’s prime location in the heart of Muscat, steps from the Arabian Sea, puts you close to the city’s top cultural attractions
findings.note: The hotel page states both the heart-of-Muscat location and the proximity to the Arabian Sea.

claims.text: Rooms feature contemporary decor with traditional Omani touches.

findings.quote: a 42-sq.-metre room featuring contemporary decor with traditional Omani touches
findings.note: This wording is used in the room descriptions on the rooms page.

claims.text: Rooms have marble baths with a soaking tub, walk-in shower and bidet.

findings.quote: marble bath with soaking tub, walk-in shower and bidet
findings.note: Listed for the standard and pool view rooms.

claims.text: Pool View rooms have partial views of the Gulf of Oman from a private balcony.

findings.quote: Partial views of the spectacular Gulf of Oman from a private balcony welcome you to a 42-sq.-metre room
findings.note: From the 2 Twin Beds Pool View room description.

claims.text: Grand Club rooms have views of the Hajar Mountains and the Embassy district.

findings.quote: Our Grand Club rooms feature stunning views of the Hajar Mountains and Embassy district.
findings.note: Directly states both views for Grand Club rooms.

claims.text: Grand Club rooms include access to the Grand Club private lounge, serving Continental breakfast, evening drinks and hors d'oeuvres.

findings.quote: Staying in this room includes access to Grand Club private lounge serving Continental breakfast, evening drinks and hors d'oeuvres.
findings.note: Covers lounge access and all three items served.

claims.text: The master bedroom of the Crown Suites has a four-poster king bed.

findings.quote: Master suite features four-poster king bed with choice of king or twin beds in additional room.
findings.note: From the Crown Suite description.

claims.text: Club Olympus is the hotel's fitness and leisure facility, with a modern gym with cardio and strength-training machines.

findings.quote: Club Olympus, our fitness and leisure facility, which includes a modern gym fitted with cutting-edge cardio and strength-training machines.
findings.note: Names the facility and describes the gym equipment.

claims.text: The ballroom has 10-foot ceilings, crystal chandeliers and its own grand entrance.

findings.quote: a magnificent ballroom with 10-foot ceilings, crystal chandeliers, three projection screens and its own grand entrance.
findings.note: All three claimed features are stated.

claims.text: At Sirj Tea Lounge, guests relax beneath silk-draped tents with specialty teas, Arabian coffee and light dishes.

findings.quote: At Sirj Tea Lounge in Grand Hyatt Muscat, relax beneath silk-draped tents and enjoy specialty teas, Arabian coffee, and light dishes.
findings.note: Matches every element of the claim.

claims.text: The John Barry lounge has its own private terrace overlooking the hotel's garden and pool and the Arabian Sea.

findings.quote: John Barry has access to its own private terrace overlooking the hotel’s garden & pool, and Arabian Sea.
findings.note: Matches the claim.

claims.text: The pool area has an infinity pool with a lazy river, a jacuzzi, a dedicated kids' pool and a kids' play area.

findings.quote: Experience our brand-new infinity pool complete with a lazy river, jacuzzi, dedicated kids' pool and a fun-fitted kids' play.
findings.note: All listed pool features are covered.

claims.text: The hotel has views of the Hajar mountains and is steps away from the Arabian Sea.

findings.quote: With spectacular views of the majestic Hajar mountains and just steps away from the Arabian Sea
findings.note: Matches both the mountain views and the sea proximity.

claims.text: The hotel is built in authentic Arabian architecture reflecting Omani culture.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Muscat embodies the richness of Omani warmth and culture within authentic Arabian architecture.
findings.note: Matches the claim.

claims.text: The Royal Suite has a marble bath with a jetted spa tub and sauna, and butler service on request.

findings.quote: Pampering amenities include marble bath with jetted spa tub, sauna and shower, office, complimentary high-speed Internet access, butler service on request
findings.note: From the Royal Suite description.

claims.text: Crown Suites have a balcony, living and dining areas, a kitchen and a marble bath with a jetted spa tub.

findings.quote: featuring extravagant decor and unique Omani touches, balcony, living/dining areas, kitchen and marble bath with jetted spa tub.
findings.note: Crown Suite descriptions list all of these features.

claims.text: Muscat International Airport is 19 kilometers from the hotel.

findings.quote: Muscat International Airport (MCT)19 kilometers
findings.note: The parking and transportation page gives the 19 km airport distance.

findings.quote: 19 Kilometers
findings.note: The hotel information page lists the same distance under Muscat International Airport (MCT).

claims.text: Tuscany, the Italian restaurant, does not allow shorts, sandals or flip-flops.

findings.quote: Award-winning Tuscany is known to be the best Italian restaurant in Muscat.
findings.note: Identifies Tuscany as the Italian restaurant.

findings.quote: No shorts, sandals and flip-flops allowed.
findings.note: Dress restriction stated in the Tuscany section.
